mapper.select: select * from comments where board_no=#{boardNo} order by created_at desc
mapper.delete: delete from comments where comment_no=#{commentNo} and board_no=#{boardNo}
mapper.update: update board set comment_count=comment_count+1 where board_no =#{boardNo}
update board set comment_count=comment_count-1 where board_no =#{boardNo}
update comments set content=#{content} where comment_no = #{commentNo}
